metadata.description: Deterministic eligibility records for a small set of centrally administered Government of India schemes.
metadata.source_policy: Official government or statutory-regulator sources only. Eligibility is a preliminary check; the administering authority makes the final decision.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
schemes.description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers. The official scheme page states that an eligible subscriber receives a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60, subject to contributions and scheme terms.
schemes.benefit_summary: Minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60, with an age-based subscriber contribution matched by the Central Government.

eligibility_rules.description: The applicant is an unorganised worker in an occupation covered by the scheme description.
eligibility_rules.pass_message: You indicated that you work in the unorganised sector.
eligibility_rules.fail_message: PM-SYM is intended for unorganised workers; your answer does not meet that condition.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Whether your work falls within the unorganised sector is not yet known.
eligibility_rules.question: Do you work in the unorganised sector (for example, as a home-based worker, street vendor, domestic worker, agricultural worker, construction worker, or a similar occupation)?

eligibility_rules.description: Entry age is from 18 through 40 years, inclusive.

eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Your age is needed to apply the PM-SYM entry-age rule.
eligibility_rules.question: What is your age in completed years?

eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Your monthly income is needed to apply the PM-SYM income limit.
eligibility_rules.question: What is your approximate monthly income in rupees?

required_documents: Consent form for auto-debit from the linked account
application_process: Keep a mobile phone, Aadhaar number, and savings-bank or Jan-Dhan account details ready.
Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), or use the official Maandhan portal where self-enrolment is available.
Complete the self-certified enrolment and auto-debit consent.
Pay the first contribution at enrolment as instructed; later contributions are collected from the linked account.
Keep the receipt and the pension account/card details issued after enrolment.
schemes.source: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India — PM-SYM scheme details

additional_sources.title: Ministry of Labour & Employment PM-SYM FAQ

schemes.verification_note: This check is for a new enrolment and does not calculate the age-based contribution. The administering authority makes the final eligibility decision.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.description: A voluntary pension scheme for eligible Indian citizens. The pension amount after age 60 depends on the selected pension slab and prescribed contributions.
schemes.benefit_summary: Government-guaranteed minimum pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000, or 5,000 per month after age 60, depending on the selected slab and contributions.
schemes.target_group: Indian citizens meeting the APY new-account conditions

eligibility_rules.fail_message: APY is open to Indian citizens; your answer does not meet this condition.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Citizenship is needed to check the APY condition.
eligibility_rules.question: Are you an Indian citizen?

eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Your age is needed to apply the APY entry-age rule.

eligibility_rules.question: As on the application date, are you or have you ever been an income-tax payer under the Income-tax Act, 1961?

eligibility_rules.question: Do you already have an Atal Pension Yojana account?

required_documents: Savings-bank or post-office savings-bank account details (mandatory)
Proof of possession of Aadhaar or Aadhaar-enrolment details; the official FAQ says Aadhaar details may be supplied after enrolment if not supplied initially
Physical APY account-opening and auto-debit form when applying through a branch; e-APY uses a digital process
application_process: Approach the bank branch or post office where your savings account is held, or first open an eligible savings account.
Alternatively, follow the e-APY digital onboarding option linked from PFRDA's official APY information.
Choose a pension slab and contribution frequency, provide nominee details, and authorise auto-debit.
Submit Aadhaar details at enrolment or in due course as described in the official FAQ.
Keep sufficient funds in the linked account for the prescribed contribution.
schemes.source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority — Atal Pension Yojana FAQ

additional_sources.title: PFRDA notice confirming APY continuation through 2030-31

schemes.verification_note: This check is for opening a new APY account. The income-tax exclusion does not cancel accounts opened on or before 30 September 2022 merely because the subscriber was or later became an income-tax payer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: A Central Sector income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to the official exclusion categories and State/UT verification.
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 6,000 per year paid by direct benefit transfer in three equal instalments to eligible farmer families, subject to exclusions and verification.

eligibility_rules.description: The applicant belongs to a farmer family owning cultivable land under the concerned State/UT land-record system or an approved State-specific identification mechanism.
eligibility_rules.pass_message: You indicated that your farmer family owns cultivable land under the applicable State/UT identification system.
eligibility_rules.fail_message: PM-KISAN is for landholding farmer families with cultivable land under the applicable State/UT identification system.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Your family's cultivable-land status under the State/UT system is needed.
eligibility_rules.question: Does your farmer family own cultivable land under your State/UT land records or an officially approved local identification mechanism?

eligibility_rules.description: The official guidelines and current portal flag post-1-February-2019 land acquisition other than qualifying succession/inheritance for exclusion or verification.
eligibility_rules.pass_message: You did not report a post-1-February-2019 acquisition that falls outside the stated inheritance/succession exception.
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Land acquired after 1 February 2019 other than through the stated inheritance/succession exception is flagged as ineligible or requiring official verification under the scheme guidance.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: How and when the cultivable land was acquired is needed for this check.
eligibility_rules.question: Was the cultivable land acquired after 1 February 2019 for a reason other than inheritance/succession following a landholder's death?

eligibility_rules.description: Institutional landholders are excluded.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: All institutional landholders are excluded under the PM-KISAN operational guidelines.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Whether the landholder is an institution is not yet known.
eligibility_rules.question: Is the cultivable land held by an institution rather than an individual farmer family?

eligibility_rules.pass_message: You indicated that no family member is a former or present holder of a constitutional post.
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The PM-KISAN guidelines exclude a farmer family when a member is a former or present holder of a constitutional post.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Whether a family member holds or held a constitutional post is not yet known.
eligibility_rules.question: Does any member of the farmer family currently hold, or formerly hold, a constitutional post?

eligibility_rules.description: Specified former and present ministers, legislators, municipal-corporation mayors, and district-panchayat chairpersons trigger exclusion.
eligibility_rules.pass_message: You indicated that no family member falls within the specified elected-office exclusion.
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The PM-KISAN guidelines exclude farmer families containing a member in one of the specified former or present elected offices.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Whether a family member falls within the specified elected-office categories is not yet known.
eligibility_rules.question: Is any family member a former or present Minister/State Minister, MP, State legislator, Mayor of a Municipal Corporation, or Chairperson of a District Panchayat?

eligibility_rules.description: Specified serving or retired government, PSE, autonomous-institution, and regular local-body personnel are excluded; Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV, and Group D employees are excepted by the guideline.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The PM-KISAN guidelines exclude the specified serving or retired government-related employees, except the stated Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D categories.
eligibility_rules.unknown_message: Whether a family member falls within the non-exempt government-employee category is not yet known.
eligibility_rules.question: Does any family member fall within the specified serving/retired government, PSE, autonomous-institution, or regular local-body employee categories, excluding Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D?

eligibility_rules.description: A superannuated or retired pensioner receiving Rs 10,000 or more per month triggers exclusion, except the stated Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D categories.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The PM-KISAN guidelines exclude a farmer family with a non-exempt retired pensioner receiving Rs 10,000 or more per month.

eligibility_rules.question: Does any non-exempt retired family member receive a monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more (excluding the stated Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D categories)?

required_documents: Aadhaar number/card for identity authentication and mandatory eKYC
Bank account number and IFSC details for direct benefit transfer
Applicable State/UT cultivable-land record or proof accepted under an approved State-specific identification mechanism
Self-declaration covering the official exclusion categories
application_process: Use New Farmer Registration on the official PM-KISAN portal, or follow the beneficiary-identification process provided by the concerned State/UT.
Authenticate Aadhaar and provide the requested mobile, bank, family, and cultivable-land information.
Provide the exclusion-category self-declaration and any land proof required by the State/UT authority.
Complete mandatory eKYC through OTP on the portal/mobile app, biometric authentication at a CSC/State Seva Kendra, or an officially available face-authentication method.
The State/UT authority verifies landholding and eligibility before approval; use Know Your Status on the official portal to follow the result.
schemes.contact_guidance: Use the Help-Desk and State Nodal Officer links on the official PM-KISAN Contact Us page: https://pmkisan.gov.in/Contacts.aspx
schemes.source: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — Revised PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines

additional_sources.title: Official PM-KISAN portal and current eligibility-verification notices
Official note on PM-KISAN eKYC modes

schemes.verification_note: State/UT land records and approved local identification mechanisms control beneficiary identification. This engine cannot validate land records, Aadhaar, eKYC, family composition, or official databases; final eligibility requires State/UT and scheme verification.
